settings.heading: Size Charts
settings.tab_1_intro: Use a flexible measuring tape where you would normally wear your bracelet, just above the wrist bone.
settings.tab_1_steps:
Wrap the tape around your wrist without pulling it tightly.
Keep one finger beneath the tape to allow for natural movement.
Record your wrist measurement in inches or centimeters.
settings.tab_1_note:
No tape available? Wrap a strip of paper or non-stretch string around your wrist, mark where the ends meet, then measure it flat with a ruler.

CHOOSE YOUR PREFERRED FIT
The size chart provides a comfortable standard fit. For a closer fit, choose the size nearest to your wrist measurement. For a more relaxed fit, or if you are between sizes, choose the larger size.
settings.tab_2_intro: To determine your wrist size for a cuff, follow these steps:
settings.tab_2_steps:
Use a Tape Measure: wrap it around your wrist just below the wrist bone, ensuring the numbers face out.
Mark and Measure: note where the ends meet and measure the length with a ruler.
Adjust for Comfort: ensure the measurement fits comfortably around your wrist.
settings.tab_2_note: If you fall between two sizes, we recommend choosing the larger size for a better fit.
